title: PCR 2019:14 Construction products (EN 15804+A2), version 2.0.1
program_operator: EPD International AB (The International EPD System)

document.status_note: Validity as stated in the document; may change, see environdec.com (not re-checked online).

depends_on_unavailable: EN 15804:2012+A2:2019/AC:2021 (indicator Tables 3-7, Table 5 disclaimers, scenario Tables 10-15, Annex D)
General Programme Instructions of the International EPD System v5.0.1

scenarios.D.mmr_out_basis.source: §4.8.5, p.41 (PEF Annex C R2 values unless c-PCR gives M_MR,out)

rules.title: EPD system-boundary type is one of the six PCR types
rules.requirement: The EPD must be one of the system-boundary types a) to f) defined by the PCR (cradle-to-gate with C+D, cradle-to-gate with options + C+D, cradle-to-grave + D, cradle-to-gate, cradle-to-gate with options, construction service A1-A5).

rules.title: Scope keyword consistent with allowed scopes
rules.requirement: The declared scope must be cradle-to-gate, cradle-to-gate with options, or cradle-to-grave; no other scope label is permitted.

rules.title: Cradle-to-grave (type c) needs a functional unit
rules.requirement: A type c EPD (cradle to grave and module D) must be based on a functional unit; this is stricter than EN 15804.

rules.title: Cradle-to-grave (type c) needs a c-PCR
rules.requirement: A type c EPD must use a complementary PCR together with this main PCR, so at least two PCRs must be referenced.

rules.title: Module C exclusion requires all four criteria
rules.requirement: Excluding the end-of-life stage (types d and e) is only allowed if the product is physically integrated with other products, is no longer identifiable at end of life, contains no biogenic carbon, and the EPD is not for business-to-consumer use.

check.expression: lca.module_c_exclusion.physically_integrated == true and lca.module_c_exclusion.not_identifiable_at_eol == true and lca.module_c_exclusion.no_biogenic_carbon == true and lca.module_c_exclusion.not_b2c == true

rules.title: Module C exclusion: product biogenic carbon must be zero
rules.requirement: For types d and e, the declared biogenic carbon content of the product must be zero, as products containing biogenic carbon cannot exclude module C.

rules.title: PCR referenced with registration number, name and version
rules.requirement: Any reference to this PCR must state its registration number (2019:14), name and version number.

rules.title: Reference PCR entries are complete
rules.requirement: Each PCR used (main PCR and any c-PCR) must be identified with name, registration number and version.

rules.title: EPDs without a c-PCR use a declared unit
rules.requirement: When the EPD is based on this PCR alone (no c-PCR), a declared unit must be used rather than a functional unit.

rules.title: A1-A3 declared, in aggregated form
rules.requirement: Modules A1-A3 are mandatory for every EPD type and their results must be declared aggregated as A1-A3.

rules.title: C1-C4 and D mandatory for types a, b and c
rules.requirement: EPDs of types a, b and c must declare all end-of-life modules C1-C4 and module D.

rules.title: Cradle-to-grave declares all A4-A5 and B modules
rules.requirement: Type c EPDs must declare A4, A5 and all use-stage modules B1-B7 in addition to A1-A3, C1-C4 and D.

rules.title: Type a: no A4-A5 or B modules
rules.requirement: For type a (cradle to gate with C1-C4 and D), modules A4-A5 and B1-B7 are not applicable.

rules.title: Type d: only A1-A3
rules.requirement: A type d EPD (cradle to gate) covers A1-A3 only; no other modules may be declared.

rules.title: Type e: only A4 and/or A5 as options
rules.requirement: A type e EPD (cradle to gate with options) may add only A4 and/or A5 to A1-A3; B, C and D modules are not part of this type.

rules.title: Construction services declare A4 and A5
rules.requirement: EPDs of construction services (type f, and type b when the product is a service) must include modules A4 and A5; the execution of the service is assigned to A5 and transport to site to A4.

rules.title: Service with reused physical product declares C and D
rules.requirement: A service EPD involving a physical product used across several construction works (e.g., rental) must declare C1-C4 and D.

rules.title: Packaging with biogenic carbon requires A5
rules.requirement: If the packaging contains biogenic carbon, module A5 must be included unless the EPD is of type a or d.

rules.title: Energy-using products include B6
rules.requirement: Products that use energy in the use stage, directly or indirectly (e.g., through losses), must include module B6.

rules.title: No sub-totals or totals across modules (other than A1-A3)
rules.requirement: Apart from the mandatory A1-A3 aggregate, results of individual modules must not be summed into totals or sub-totals of stages A, B, C or D.

rules.title: Trader EPD includes A3 trader processes
rules.requirement: For EPDs owned by a trader, transport to the central warehouse/market border (and to the store for retailers) and any own packaging must be included and assigned to module A3.

rules.title: Declared unit should be in SI units
rules.requirement: The declared unit should relate to typical applications and be in SI units (kg, J, m, etc.); other units such as kW or kWh may be used if more relevant.

rules.title: Conversion factor to mass when unit is not mass
rules.requirement: If mass is not the declared/functional unit, a factor converting results to mass must be declared (not applicable to services).
rules.applies_when: declared_unit.unit != 'kg' and declared_unit.unit != 't' and product.is_service != true

rules.title: Mass conversion factor shown in LCA information section
rules.requirement: Conversion factors to mass belong in the LCA information section; other conversion factors go in the additional environmental information section.
rules.applies_when: declared_unit.unit != 'kg' and declared_unit.unit != 't' and product.is_service != true

rules.title: Area unit: area density and thickness declared
rules.requirement: If the declared unit is an area, area density (kg/m2) and thickness (m) must be declared.

rules.title: Area unit: thickness declared
rules.requirement: If the declared unit is an area, the product thickness (m) must be declared.

rules.title: Volume or other unit: density declared
rules.requirement: If the declared unit is a volume or any unit other than area, length, piece or mass, volumetric mass density (kg/m3) must be declared.
rules.applies_when: declared_unit.unit != 'm2' and declared_unit.unit != 'm' and declared_unit.unit != 'piece' and declared_unit.unit != 'item' and declared_unit.unit != 'kg' and declared_unit.unit != 't' and product.is_service != true

rules.title: Length unit: linear mass density declared
rules.requirement: If the declared unit is a length, linear mass density (kg/m) must be declared.

rules.title: Piece unit: mass per piece declared
rules.requirement: If the declared unit is a piece or item, the mass per piece/item (kg) must be declared.

rules.title: RSL only declared when part of a c-PCR functional unit
rules.requirement: A reference service life is declared only if a c-PCR defines it as part of the functional unit; EPDs on a declared unit should not state an RSL.

rules.title: Product lifespan declared when use stage is included
rules.requirement: A product lifespan must be declared where relevant, typically when use-stage modules are included (always the case for cradle-to-grave EPDs).
rules.applies_when: epd.boundary_type == 'c' or declared('B1') or declared('B2') or declared('B3') or declared('B4') or declared('B5') or declared('B6') or declared('B7')

rules.title: Lifespan expressed in a relevant unit
rules.requirement: Product lifespan must be expressed in relevant units such as years, operating hours or kilometres travelled.

rules.title: RSL and its relation to lifespan stated in LCA information
rules.requirement: Where an RSL applies, the LCA information section must state it and its relationship with the technical/actual lifespan.

rules.title: Cut-off by mass: 1% per unit process, 5% per module group
rules.requirement: Included LCI data must cover at least 99% of total mass inflows per unit process and 95% per module group (A1-A3, A4-A5, B1-B5, B6-B7, C1-C4, D).

rules.title: Cut-off by energy: 1% per unit process, 5% per module group
rules.requirement: Included LCI data must cover at least 99% of total energy inflows per unit process and 95% per module group.

rules.title: Cut-off by impact: 5% per module group (ISO 21930 rule)
rules.requirement: The PCR also applies the expanded ISO 21930 rule: at least 95% of environmental impact per aggregated module group must be included.

rules.title: Applied cut-offs described in the EPD
rules.requirement: Any use of cut-off rules, including the LCI data excluded, must be described in the EPD.

rules.title: Excluded flows documented with justification
rules.requirement: Each flow excluded by cut-off must be justified by sensitivity analysis and/or conservative assumptions and documented verifiably in the LCA report.

rules.title: Infrastructure/capital goods >10% described in EPD
rules.requirement: If infrastructure/capital goods are included and contribute more than 10% to A1-A3 (A1-A5 for services) results of any declared impact indicator, the EPD must describe for which stages/processes they are included.

rules.title: Database declared for datasets with embedded capital goods >5%
rules.requirement: If a generic dataset that includes capital goods contributes over 5% to cradle-to-gate results of any impact indicator, its source database must be declared in the EPD.

rules.title: Power-plant construction included for A3 electricity/heat
rules.requirement: For electricity/heat used in A3 (A5 for services) and other processes under the EPD owner's control, at least power-plant construction must be included in the datasets.

rules.title: No system expansion/substitution to solve allocation
rules.requirement: Allocation problems must be solved by subdivision or allocation, never by system expansion or substitution credits (attributional approach).

rules.title: Allocation basis is one of the permitted methods
rules.requirement: Co-product allocation follows the stepwise procedure: subdivision, then physical allocation, otherwise economic allocation; conservative assumptions are permitted.

rules.title: Physical allocation only if revenue difference <25%
rules.requirement: Physical allocation is only allowed when a relevant physical relationship exists and the revenue per mass (or energy) of product and co-products differs by less than 25%.

rules.title: Economic allocation requires sensitivity analysis
rules.requirement: Where economic allocation is used, the LCA report must include a sensitivity analysis on the choice of economic value.

rules.title: Allocation basis justified
rules.requirement: The allocation procedure applied must be documented and justified (LCA report, and EPD where recycled material is a main flow).

rules.title: SCM co-products for cement/concrete: economic allocation only
rules.requirement: Co-products used in cement and concrete (e.g., GGBS, BOF slag, fly ash, artificial gypsum, silica fume, alumina-rich residues) must be allocated economically; physical partitioning or system expansion is not allowed.

rules.title: Economic allocation prices averaged over >=3 years
rules.requirement: Economic allocation for cement/concrete co-products should use market prices averaged over a long period, recommended at least 3 years.

rules.title: Incineration below 60/65% efficiency is disposal (C4)
rules.requirement: Waste incineration in stage C counts as energy recovery (C3) only if energy efficiency is at least 60% (plants permitted before 2009) or 65% (after 2009); otherwise, and always for hazardous waste, it is disposal in C4.

rules.title: Recycled-material allocation described in EPD
rules.requirement: If pre- or post-consumer recycled material is a main input or output, the EPD must describe the allocation applied, including whether real data or estimates were used and the share assumed to carry/not carry burden.

rules.title: GWP-GHG intensity of recycled inputs declared when >10%
rules.requirement: If recycled material inputs contribute more than 10% to A1-A3 GWP-GHG, the GWP-GHG intensity of that recycled material (kg CO2 eq./tonne) must be declared.

rules.title: Mass balance approaches not used
rules.requirement: Mass balance approaches for claiming biobased, renewable or recycled content are not allowed (except grid biogas and the rolling-average percentage method).

rules.title: Primary data reference year <= 5 years
rules.requirement: Primary data reference year (latest year the data provider confirmed representativeness) must be no more than five years old.

rules.title: Secondary data reference year <= 10 years
rules.requirement: Representative secondary data must not have a reference year older than 10 years; older data counts as proxy data.

rules.title: Database version not older than 3 years
rules.requirement: Database datasets should be from the latest version; if not, the database version must be no more than three years old when the EPD is published.

rules.title: Primary data cover at least one year of operations
rules.requirement: Primary data should be averaged over at least one year of operations; any shorter period must be justified.

rules.title: Data collection period declared in EPD
rules.requirement: The data quality summary in the EPD must state the data collection period of primary manufacturing (or service provision) data, with justification for any deviation from one year.

rules.title: Data quality assessment covers >=80% of each impact indicator
rules.requirement: A data quality assessment per EN 15941 must cover data contributing at least 80% of the results of each declared environmental impact indicator.

rules.title: Data quality assessment scheme
rules.requirement: The assessment must use the data quality schemes of the UN Environment Global Guidance or the PEF method.

rules.title: Data quality summary in LCA information section
rules.requirement: A summary of the data quality assessment must be included in the LCA information section of the EPD.

rules.title: Data source declaration for key A1-A3 processes
rules.requirement: For each process contributing over 10% of A1-A3 GWP-GHG (A1-A5 for services), the EPD must give source type, source, reference year and data category; other processes may be grouped.

rules.title: A3 reference year always declared
rules.requirement: The reference year(s) of manufacturing data in A3 (service provision in A5) must be declared even if below the 10% threshold.

rules.title: Share of primary data for A1-A3 GWP-GHG declared
rules.requirement: The total share of primary data in A1-A3 GWP-GHG results (A1-A5 for services) must be declared; '>90%' is allowed above 90%.

rules.title: Primary-data-share explanatory statement
rules.requirement: Next to the primary data share, the EPD must include the prescribed statement that the share is calculated on GWP-GHG results, is a simplified data quality indicator and is not comparable across product categories.

any_of: share of primary data is calculated based on GWP-GHG results

rules.title: Uncertainty statement when upstream EPD share is estimated
rules.requirement: If the primary data share of an upstream EPD had to be estimated, the EPD must state that the reported share is uncertain because data-source EPD(s) lack this information.

any_of: reported share of primary data is associated with uncertainty

rules.title: Statement when a non-compliant upstream EPD is used
rules.requirement: If an upstream EPD not fully compliant with the applicable LCA rules is used as data source, the EPD must describe the deviation and why that EPD was used.

rules.title: Statement when old-EF-version data are used
rules.requirement: If results based on an older EF version were used as input, the EPD must state this and that it was assessed to give identical or conservative results; the EPD is still described as using the current EF version.

rules.title: Primary data for processes under operational control
rules.requirement: Primary data must be used at least for processes under the manufacturer's (or service provider's) operational control, i.e., A3 manufacturing for goods and A5 for services.

rules.title: Proxy data limited (coverage of data quality assessment)
rules.requirement: Proxy data use must be identified in the data quality assessment covering at least 80% of each core impact indicator result.

rules.title: A3 electricity modelled market-based
rules.requirement: Grid electricity for A1-A3 processes under the manufacturer's control must be modelled market-based (contractual instrument or residual mix); location-based consumption mix is not allowed for main results.

rules.title: A3 electricity GWP-GHG intensity declared (kg CO2 eq./kWh)
rules.requirement: The EPD must declare the climate impact of electricity used in A3 (A5 for services) in kg CO2 eq./kWh using GWP-GHG.

rules.title: A3 electricity energy source and modelling described
rules.requirement: The EPD must state how A3 electricity was modelled (e.g., contractual instrument, residual mix) and the energy source behind it.

rules.title: Electricity intensity unit shown in EPD
rules.requirement: The electricity climate impact must be expressed in kg CO2 eq./kWh in the EPD.

rules.title: Residual mix calculation method reported
rules.requirement: When a residual mix had to be calculated, the method used (AIB method for AIB members) must be reported in the LCA report and the EPD.

rules.title: Sub-national grid for AU, BR, CA, CN, IN, US
rules.requirement: The electricity market is the country grid, except Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, India and the USA, where a sub-national grid mix must be used.
rules.applies_when: lca.electricity.a3.country == 'AU' or lca.electricity.a3.country == 'BR' or lca.electricity.a3.country == 'CA' or lca.electricity.a3.country == 'CN' or lca.electricity.a3.country == 'IN' or lca.electricity.a3.country == 'US'

rules.title: Contractual instrument documentation complete
rules.requirement: Documentation of purchased and cancelled contractual instruments must identify generator, electricity type and quantity, purchaser, and issue/validity periods.

rules.title: Contractual instrument volume covers annual production
rules.requirement: Contractual instruments bought per year must correspond to the electricity used to produce the annual sales volume of all products at the site.

rules.title: Location-based results only in separate subsection
rules.requirement: Location-based electricity/biogas results may only be given in a clearly described subsection of the environmental performance section, not as main results.

rules.title: B6 electricity mix declared
rules.requirement: Electricity in the use stage is modelled with the market consumption mix (unless under the EPD owner's control) and the mix must be declared in the EPD where relevant.

rules.title: A3 biogas GWP-GHG intensity declared (kg CO2 eq./MJ)
rules.requirement: If biogas is used in A3 (A5 for services), the EPD must describe its modelling and declare its climate impact in kg CO2 eq./MJ using GWP-GHG.

rules.title: Grid biogas modelled market-based
rules.requirement: Grid biogas for energy must be modelled with certificates or the residual gas mix (often 100% natural gas); internal/dedicated supply may be modelled as biogas if no certificates were sold.

rules.title: Biogenic content >5%: share declared
rules.requirement: If the product contains more than 5% biogenic material, its share (mass-%) must be declared in the content declaration.

rules.title: Biogenic content >5%: kg C per unit declared
rules.requirement: If biogenic content exceeds 5%, the biogenic carbon content must be declared in kg C per product or declared unit.

rules.title: ISO 21930 claim: biogenic carbon in kg CO2 eq.
rules.requirement: EPDs claiming ISO 21930 compliance must also declare the biogenic carbon content of product and packaging in kg CO2 eq. per product or declared unit.

rules.title: Biogenic carbon kg CO2 eq. = kg C x 44/12
rules.requirement: 1 kg biogenic carbon corresponds to 44/12 kg CO2; declared kg C and kg CO2 eq. values must be consistent.

rules.title: Packaging biogenic content >5% declared
rules.requirement: If packaging contains more than 5% biogenic material, this share must be declared.

rules.title: Biogenic carbon balances to zero over A-C
rules.requirement: Biogenic carbon taken up and the biogenic carbon emitted or leaving the system over the life cycle must sum to zero; no credits for storage or delayed emissions.

rules.title: Statement when biogenic packaging carbon balanced in A1-A3
rules.requirement: For type a/d EPDs with biogenic packaging, the packaging uptake must be balanced by a virtual emission in A3 and this must be stated in the environmental performance section.

rules.title: GWP-GHG A1-A3 consistent with GWP-total + biogenic content
rules.requirement: For A1-A3, GWP-GHG may be computed as GWP-total plus product and packaging biogenic carbon content times 44/12; results should be consistent with this identity.

rules.title: Core environmental impact indicators (EN 15804+A2)
rules.requirement: All mandatory core impact indicators of EN 15804+A2 (EF 3.1 reference package) must be declared for every declared module; ND is not allowed for mandatory indicators.

rules.title: Supplementary GWP-GHG indicator
rules.requirement: GWP-GHG (GWP-total with biogenic CO2 characterisation factor set to zero) must additionally be declared for every declared module.

rules.title: Resource use indicators
rules.requirement: The EN 15804 resource use indicators, including the six primary energy indicators (MJ, net calorific value), secondary materials, secondary fuels and net fresh water, must be declared for every declared module.

rules.title: Waste indicators
rules.requirement: The EN 15804 waste category indicators (hazardous, non-hazardous, radioactive waste disposed) must be declared for every declared module.

rules.title: Output flow indicators, exported energy per carrier
rules.requirement: The EN 15804 output flow indicators must be declared for every declared module, with exported energy split into electricity and thermal energy.

rules.title: Additional EN 15804 impact indicators calculated
rules.requirement: The additional EN 15804 impact indicators must be calculated and given in the LCA report; declaring them in the EPD (or a public report) is optional but recommended.

rules.title: Characterisation factors based on EF 3.1
rules.requirement: Since 2024-09-01, characterisation factors from the EN 15804 reference package based on EF 3.1 (or a later version) must be used.

rules.title: Reference package version stated in EPD
rules.requirement: The EPD must state which EN 15804 reference package version was used (e.g., EF 3.1) with references to characterisation methods for all declared indicators.

rules.title: Impact results disclaimer
rules.requirement: Next to the impact indicator results, the EPD must state that estimated impact results are relative statements that do not indicate endpoints, threshold exceedance, safety margins or risks.

any_of: only relative statements, which do not indicate the endpoints

rules.title: End-of-life consideration statement
rules.requirement: If the EPD covers the end-of-life stage, it must state that results of C1-C4 should be considered together with A1-A3 (A1-A5 for services).
rules.applies_when: declared('C1') or declared('C2') or declared('C3') or declared('C4')

any_of: results of the end-of-life stage (modules C1-C4) should be considered

rules.title: EN 15804 indicator disclaimers present
rules.requirement: The EPD must include the EN 15804 disclaimers belonging to the declared indicators (e.g., the 'use with care' disclaimer for ADP and WDP).

any_of: shall be used with care as the uncertainties on these results are high

rules.title: Primary energy option (A/B/C) stated next to results
rules.requirement: The option chosen (A, B or C) for splitting primary energy into raw-material and energy-carrier use must be described directly with the primary energy results.

rules.title: Statement when recovered energy balanced in A1-A3
rules.requirement: If recovered energy leaving in A5 or C is balanced out in A1-A3 because those modules are not included, this must be stated in the environmental performance section.

rules.title: EN 15804+A1 indicators clearly labelled
rules.requirement: If EN 15804+A1 indicators are additionally declared, the EPD must make clear they are A1 characterisation methods while all other rules follow EN 15804+A2, without claiming A1 compliance.

rules.title: EPD published in English
rules.requirement: EPDs must at minimum be published in English; other language versions must have identical content and the same registration number.

rules.title: Machine-readable ILCD+EPD version available
rules.requirement: EPDs under this PCR must also be made digitally available in the machine-readable ILCD+EPD format.

rules.title: Two significant figures for results
rules.requirement: Results and the content declaration should use two significant figures; scientific notation (e.g., 1.2E+2) may be used.

rules.title: Number style is one of the SI styles
rules.requirement: Thousand separator and decimal mark must follow SI English (1 234.56) or SI French (1 234,56) style.

rules.title: Result tables use ND, never MND, blanks or symbols
rules.requirement: Result tables may only hold values or 'ND' (for optional indicators lacking data); no blank cells, hyphens, < or > signs, or other letters.

rules.title: No ratings, judgements or comparisons
rules.requirement: The EPD must not contain ratings, judgements, normalisation/weighting results, or comparisons with other products, earlier versions or competitors.

rules.title: No carbon-neutrality or MBA-based claims
rules.requirement: Additional information must not include claims inconsistent with the PCR LCA rules, e.g., carbon-neutrality claims or GHG reductions based on mass balance.

rules.title: Variation calculated relative to the mean of the two values
rules.requirement: Percentage variation between two numbers is |difference| divided by their average, times 100; where several values are compared, the maximum variation is declared.
rules.applies_when: epd.multi_product_basis == 'average' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'representative' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'several-representative' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'worst-case'

rules.title: Section present: Cover page
rules.requirement: The EPD must contain the 'Cover page' section required by the PCR's fixed EPD structure.

rules.title: Section present: General information: programme information
rules.requirement: The EPD must contain the 'General information: programme information' section required by the PCR's fixed EPD structure.

rules.title: Section present: General information: PCR and verification
rules.requirement: The EPD must contain the 'General information: PCR and verification' section required by the PCR's fixed EPD structure.

rules.title: Section present: General information: ownership and limitations on use
rules.requirement: The EPD must contain the 'General information: ownership and limitations on use' section required by the PCR's fixed EPD structure.

rules.title: Section present: Information about EPD owner
rules.requirement: The EPD must contain the 'Information about EPD owner' section required by the PCR's fixed EPD structure.

rules.title: Section present: Product information
rules.requirement: The EPD must contain the 'Product information' section required by the PCR's fixed EPD structure.

rules.title: Section present: Content declaration
rules.requirement: The EPD must contain the 'Content declaration' section required by the PCR's fixed EPD structure.

rules.title: Section present: LCA information
rules.requirement: The EPD must contain the 'LCA information' section required by the PCR's fixed EPD structure.

rules.title: Section present: Environmental performance
rules.requirement: The EPD must contain the 'Environmental performance' section required by the PCR's fixed EPD structure.

rules.title: Section present: Abbreviations
rules.requirement: The EPD must contain the 'Abbreviations' section required by the PCR's fixed EPD structure.

rules.title: Section present: References
rules.requirement: The EPD must contain the 'References' section required by the PCR's fixed EPD structure.

rules.title: Section present: Version history
rules.requirement: The EPD must contain the 'Version history' section required by the PCR's fixed EPD structure.

rules.title: Sector EPD information section
rules.requirement: Sector EPDs must include the section with information related to sector EPDs.

rules.title: Cover: product name
rules.requirement: The cover page must show the product name.

rules.title: Cover: EPD owner name
rules.requirement: The cover page must show the EPD owner's name.

rules.title: Cover: EPD owner logotype
rules.requirement: The cover page must show the EPD owner's logotype.

rules.title: Cover: 'Environmental Product Declaration' text
rules.requirement: The cover page must contain the text 'Environmental Product Declaration' and/or 'EPD'.

rules.title: Cover: programme name and website
rules.requirement: The cover page must name the programme as The International EPD System with www.environdec.com.

rules.title: Cover: programme operator
rules.requirement: The cover page must name the programme operator EPD International AB.

rules.title: Cover: programme/licensee logotype
rules.requirement: The cover page must show the International EPD System logotype (or the licensee/CLC logotype).

rules.title: Cover: registration number
rules.requirement: The cover page must show the EPD registration number issued by the programme operator (not a certification-body number).

rules.title: Cover: version date
rules.requirement: The cover page must show the version date (YYYY-MM-DD).

rules.title: Cover: validity date
rules.requirement: The cover page must show the validity date; version date and validity period must be stated in the EPD.

rules.title: Cover: update/depublish statement
rules.requirement: The cover page must say that the EPD may be updated or depublished if conditions change and point to www.environdec.com for the latest version.

any_of: may be updated or depublished if conditions change

rules.title: Cover: ISO 14025 conformity
rules.requirement: The cover page must state conformity with ISO 14025.

rules.title: Cover: EN 15804+A2/AC conformity
rules.requirement: The cover page must state conformity with EN 15804:2012+A2:2019/AC:2021.

rules.title: Cover: ISO 21930 conformity when claimed
rules.requirement: If ISO 21930 compliance is claimed, the cover page must state conformity with ISO 21930:2017.

rules.title: Cover: ECO EPD logotype
rules.requirement: The cover page must show the ECO EPD logotype approved by ECO Platform.

rules.title: Cover: licensee name
rules.requirement: If registered via a regional/national licensee, the cover page must name the licensee.

rules.title: Cover: multiple-products statement and type
rules.requirement: EPDs of multiple products must state on the cover that they cover multiple products and which option (average, representative product, several representative products, worst-case) is used.
rules.applies_when: epd.multi_product_basis == 'average' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'representative' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'several-representative' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'worst-case'

any_of: EPD of multiple products, based on the average results of the product group
EPD of multiple products, based on a representative product
EPD of multiple products, based on several representative products
EPD of multiple products, based on worst-case results

rules.title: Cover: list of products covered
rules.requirement: EPDs of multiple products must list all covered products on the cover (or, if more than 10, in product information with a reference on the cover).
rules.applies_when: epd.multi_product_basis == 'average' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'representative' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'several-representative' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'worst-case'

rules.title: Cover: sector EPD type statement
rules.requirement: Sector EPDs must state on the cover whether they are based on an average or a worst-case product.

any_of: Sector EPD based on an average product
Sector EPD based on a worst-case product

rules.title: Not-yet-on-market disclaimer
rules.requirement: EPDs of products not yet on the market must carry the prescribed 'not yet on the market' use-with-care disclaimer on the cover and in product information.

rules.title: Recently-on-market disclaimer
rules.requirement: EPDs whose A3 data cover less than one year of production must carry the prescribed 'recently on the market' disclaimer on the cover and in product information.

rules.title: Self-declared translation disclaimer
rules.requirement: A self-declared translation must carry a cover disclaimer that it is a translation of the verified EPD and that only the original is binding.

rules.title: Programme operator address
rules.requirement: The programme information must give the operator address: EPD International AB, Box 210 60, SE-100 31 Stockholm, Sweden, support@environdec.com.

rules.title: PCR statement: EN 15804 as core PCR
rules.requirement: The PCR information must state that CEN standard EN 15804 serves as the core PCR (adding ISO 21930 if compliance is claimed).

any_of: EN 15804 serves as the core Product Category Rules

rules.title: PCR statement: name, number, version, UN CPC
rules.requirement: The PCR information must give the PCR name, registration number, version and UN CPC code(s), plus the same for any c-PCR.

rules.title: PCR review chair named
rules.requirement: The EPD must name the PCR review chair and organisation and how to contact them via the programme operator.

rules.title: Ownership statement
rules.requirement: The EPD must state that the EPD owner has sole ownership, liability and responsibility for the EPD.

rules.title: Comparability limitation statement
rules.requirement: The EPD must include the prescribed statement that EPDs from different programmes may not be comparable and the conditions for comparability.

any_of: published in different EPD programmes, may not be comparable

rules.title: EPD owner address and contact
rules.requirement: The EPD must give the address and contact details of the EPD owner.

rules.title: EPD owner organisation description
rules.requirement: The EPD must describe the EPD owner's organisation.

rules.title: LCA practitioner contact
rules.requirement: If an LCA practitioner was commissioned, their address and contact information must be given.

rules.title: Product unambiguous identification
rules.requirement: The product must be identified by name and unambiguously by standards, concessions or other means.

rules.title: Product image
rules.requirement: Product information must include a visual representation (e.g., image) of the product.

rules.title: UN CPC classification code
rules.requirement: The product must be identified by UN CPC name and code where an applicable code exists.

rules.title: Product description and intended use
rules.requirement: Product information must describe the product, its technical performance, intended use and any restriction to construction types.

rules.title: Main manufacturing processes described
rules.requirement: Product information must briefly describe the main manufacturing (or service provision) processes.

rules.title: Manufacturer name
rules.requirement: If the manufacturer or service provider differs from the EPD owner, it must be named.

rules.title: Manufacturing site locations (city)
rules.requirement: The location of every manufacturing site must be given, at least to city/municipality level; multi-site EPDs must list all A3 sites.

rules.title: At least one manufacturing site listed
rules.requirement: At least one manufacturing site (or service location) must be listed.

rules.title: Trader: final controlled site location
rules.requirement: Trader-owned EPDs must state the city of the final site under the trader's direct control (warehouse or store) as well as manufacturing sites.

rules.title: Mass per unit declared
rules.requirement: The mass of one unit of product, as purchased or per declared unit, must be declared.

rules.title: Material/substance list with masses
rules.requirement: Content must be declared as a list of materials/substances with their masses (confidential items may be generic or ranged).

rules.title: Material list not empty
rules.requirement: The content declaration must contain at least one material entry (an empty declaration needs an explanation, services only).

rules.title: Packaging mass and content
rules.requirement: Mass and material content of distribution/consumer packaging must be declared where applicable.

rules.title: Content declaration covers 100% of unit mass
rules.requirement: Declared material masses must add up to 100% of one product unit (except worst-case multi-product EPDs).

rules.title: Post-consumer recycled content >5% declared
rules.requirement: If post-consumer recycled content exceeds 5%, its share must be declared (pre-consumer, if declared, separately).

rules.title: SVHC above 0.1% declared
rules.requirement: Substances on the REACH SVHC candidate list above 0.1% by weight of the product or any component must be declared with their properties.

rules.title: Multi-product/sector: content declaration basis explained
rules.requirement: EPDs of multiple products and sector EPDs must explain what the content declaration represents (average, representative or worst-case).
rules.applies_when: epd.multi_product_basis == 'average' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'representative' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'several-representative' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'worst-case' or epd.type == 'sector'

rules.title: Geographical scope per module
rules.requirement: The LCA information must state the geographical scope per module (A1-A5) and for stages B and C, by country code or region name.

rules.title: System boundary description phrase
rules.requirement: The LCA information must describe the system boundary with one of the six prescribed phrases matching the EPD type.

any_of: cradle-to-gate with modules C1-C4 and module D
cradle-to-gate with options, modules C1-C4, module D and optional modules
cradle-to-gate with modules A1-A5 and optional modules

rules.title: Omitted life-cycle stages justified
rules.requirement: Life-cycle stages not considered must be listed with a justification.

rules.title: Process flow diagram
rules.requirement: A process flow diagram by stage/module showing main processes, the system boundary and end-of-waste points must be included.

rules.title: LCA software name and version
rules.requirement: Name and version of the LCA software must be stated, if applicable.

rules.title: Version history: original version
rules.requirement: The version history must describe the current and previous versions with dates, with the first labelled 'original version of the EPD'.

rules.title: References: GPI and PCR
rules.requirement: The reference list must include the GPI (with version) and the PCR (registration number, name, version).

rules.title: Sector EPD: list of manufacturers
rules.requirement: Sector EPDs must list the contributing manufacturers covered.

rules.title: Sector EPD: not purchasable statement
rules.requirement: Sector EPDs must state they cover average/worst-case values for all or part of a category (with % representativeness) and that the declared product is not available for purchase.

rules.title: Representative product choice justified
rules.requirement: When results of one or several representative products are declared, the choice must be justified in the EPD.

rules.title: ISO 14026 claim: uncertainty information
rules.requirement: EPDs claiming ISO 14026 compliance must include quantitative or qualitative information on uncertainties of LCA results.

rules.title: External third-party verification
rules.requirement: The EPD and data must be verified externally and independently (third party) according to ISO 14025.

rules.title: Verification route is one of the five permitted
rules.requirement: Verification must be via individual verification (with/without pre-verified tool), EPD process certification (with/without pre-verified tool) or a fully pre-verified EPD tool.

rules.title: Third-party verifier named
rules.requirement: The EPD must name the third-party verifier (individual and organisation) or certification body.

rules.title: Verifier approval/accreditation stated
rules.requirement: The EPD must state who approved (The International EPD System) or accredited (accreditation body and number) the verifier.

rules.title: Pre-verified tool name and version
rules.requirement: When a pre-verified LCA/EPD tool is used, its name and version and the verifier accountable for tool verification must be stated.

rules.title: Process certification explanatory statement
rules.requirement: Where EPD process certification is used, the EPD must include the explanatory footnote on what process certification involves.

any_of: EPD process certification involves an accredited certification body

rules.title: Follow-up involvement of verifier declared (Yes/No)
rules.requirement: The EPD must state whether the follow-up procedure during validity involves the third-party verifier.

rules.title: Verifier in follow-up for not-yet/recently-on-market EPDs
rules.requirement: For products not yet or recently on the market, the verifier contract must ensure the verifier takes part in follow-up during validity.

rules.title: Verification statement text
rules.requirement: The verification section must state external and independent (third-party) verification according to ISO 14025:2006.

rules.title: Validity period at most five years
rules.requirement: An EPD is normally valid for five years from its version date; shorter periods are allowed, longer are not.

rules.title: Update if GWP-GHG/GWP-total rises >=10%
rules.requirement: The EPD must be updated and re-verified if changes raise aggregated GWP-GHG or GWP-total over all included stages by 10% or more (or be depublished).

rules.title: Update if any other indicator rises >=30%
rules.requirement: The EPD must be updated if a change in processes under the owner's direct control increases any other declared indicator by 30% or more over all included stages.

rules.title: Trader EPD validity not beyond manufacturer EPD
rules.requirement: A trader's EPD based on a manufacturer EPD may not be valid longer than that manufacturer EPD.

rules.title: Trader EPD references manufacturer EPDs
rules.requirement: A trader's EPD must reference the underlying manufacturer EPD(s) by registration number and programme.

rules.title: Forthcoming product needs valid similar-product EPD
rules.requirement: An EPD for a product not yet on the market requires a published, valid EPD of a similar product from the same owner under the same PCR (same first-digit version).

rules.title: Re-verification within 6 months of one-year data
rules.requirement: EPDs of products not yet/recently on the market must be updated and re-verified within six months after one year of production data becomes available, otherwise depublished.

rules.title: ISO 21930 claim: <=10% variation across grouped products
rules.requirement: Multi-product EPDs claiming ISO 21930 compliance are only allowed if no impact indicator result (aggregated A-C) differs by more than 10% between included products (sector EPDs exempt).
rules.applies_when: epd.claims_iso_21930 == true and epd.type != 'sector' and (epd.multi_product_basis == 'average' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'representative' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'several-representative' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'worst-case')

rules.title: Variation >10% declared per indicator (no ISO 21930 claim)
rules.requirement: Without an ISO 21930 claim, multi-product EPDs with >10% variation must declare the variation and an explanation for each affected impact indicator in the LCA information (worst-case EPDs exempt).

rules.title: Multi-product: A1-A3 GWP-GHG variation declared
rules.requirement: EPDs of multiple products must report the % difference in A1-A3 GWP-GHG (A1-A5 for services) between the declared result and the furthest product ('<10%' allowed).
rules.applies_when: epd.multi_product_basis == 'average' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'representative' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'several-representative' or epd.multi_product_basis == 'worst-case'

rules.title: Multi-site: A1-A3 GWP-GHG site variation declared
rules.requirement: EPDs based on several manufacturing sites must report the A1-A3 GWP-GHG difference between the declared result and the sites ('<10%' or the actual value if below 10%).

rules.title: Single-site EPDs do not report 0% site variation
rules.requirement: EPDs of a single site must not report a site variation (e.g., 0%).

rules.title: Sector EPD: variation across companies/sites declared
rules.requirement: Sector EPDs must report the A1-A3 GWP-GHG variation across represented companies/sites, with a qualitative reason if above 10% ('<10%' otherwise).

rules.title: Trader with several manufacturers: variation declared
rules.requirement: If a trader's product comes from several manufacturers, the A1-A3 GWP-GHG difference to the furthest manufacturer must be reported.

rules.title: A4 transport scenario: distance
rules.requirement: Transport to the construction site must be described, including distance, in line with EN 15804 Table 10.

rules.title: A4 transport scenario: vehicle/mode
rules.requirement: The A4 scenario must state the transport mode/vehicle and fuel, per EN 15804 Table 10.

rules.title: A4 data basis follows priority order
rules.requirement: A4 transport must be based, in priority order, on actual modes/distances, a weighted average over customers/markets, or a c-PCR default scenario.

rules.title: A5 installation scenario described
rules.requirement: Any A5 scenario must be clearly described in the EPD, including EN 15804 Table 11 information.

rules.title: Packaging end-of-life in A5
rules.requirement: End-of-life of product packaging is normally modelled in A5 following the end-of-life scenario rules.

rules.title: B6 key assumptions documented
rules.requirement: Key assumptions of the B6 use scenario (normal use, geographically representative, regulation-compliant) must be documented in the EPD.

rules.title: Mixed end-of-life scenario: 100% scenarios declared
rules.requirement: If any declared end-of-life scenario mixes routes (reuse, recycling, incineration, landfill), the corresponding relevant 100% scenarios must also be declared.

rules.title: Alternative C scenarios each have a module D counterpart
rules.requirement: Each scenario for C3 or C4 must have a corresponding module D scenario.

rules.title: C2 described with distance and transport means
rules.requirement: The description of C2 must include transport distances and means of transport.

rules.title: C2 transport means stated
rules.requirement: The C2 description must state the means of transport (vehicle type).

rules.title: C3 description includes sorted material amount
rules.requirement: The description of C3 processes must include the amount of materials being sorted.

rules.title: End-of-life scenario described per EN 15804 Table 15
rules.requirement: Assumed end-of-life scenarios must be described as realistic options for the EPD markets, including EN 15804 Table 15 information.

rules.title: C2 default distance (not incinerated) 80 km
rules.requirement: Without market-specific data, C2 transport of products/materials not incinerated must use the default of 80 km by 16-32 t EURO 5 lorry at 50% load.

rules.title: C2 default distance (incinerated) 130 km
rules.requirement: Without market-specific data, C2 transport of products/materials to incineration must use the default of 130 km by 16-32 t EURO 5 lorry at 50% load.

rules.title: C4 landfill compaction default 1.6 kWh diesel/t

rules.title: Module D assumptions declared

rules.title: Non-default M_MR,out basis justified with R2 values

rules.title: Additional scenario/method results clearly described

notes: Indicator names, abbreviations and units in IND.01-IND.06 come from EN 15804:2012+A2:2019/AC:2021 (Tables 3-7), which this PCR incorporates by reference (§4.9, p.42). The PCR itself only names GWP-GHG, GWP-total/-fossil/-biogenic/-luluc, EP-freshwater (kg P eq., p.70), the six primary energy indicators (Annex 3) and exported energy per energy carrier. Verify against EN 15804 if exact label wording matters. EEE/EET are the conventional abbreviations for exported energy electrical/thermal.
GWP-GHG is called GWP-IOBC/GHG in the ILCD+EPD+ format (§4.9 fn 65). For electricity, GWP-GHG equals GWP-total (fn 51).
The PCR uses 'ND' (Not Declared), not 'MND', both in result tables (§6.2) and the modules-declared table (§6.4.6). FMT.05 flags 'MND'. results.modules_declared[] should exclude ND modules.

Schema extensions used (not in README): (1) optional rule-level 'applies_when' expression; the rule is skipped when it is false. (2) expression function declared('<module>') meaning the module is in results.modules_declared[]. (3) literal null in expressions, meaning missing/empty. (4) '[]' paths in one_of/data_age/each_has_fields apply to every list element. (5) 'lcia_package' parameter in indicators_required. (6) indicators_required 'modules' given as the path results.modules_declared[], meaning every declared module.

epd.type vocabulary does not distinguish the four multi-product options; epd.multi_product_basis ('average','representative','several-representative','worst-case') was added. Sector EPDs use epd.type == 'sector'.

Conflict: §2.2.2.3/§4.3.7 require B6 for energy-using products, but Table 2 marks stage B as 'not applicable' for types a, d and e. It is unclear whether energy-using products must therefore be type b or c. MOD.10 applies to all types.
Validity: §2.2.4 says validity is 'normally' five years and shorter periods are accepted. VAL.01 treats 5 years as the maximum.

§4.6.1 says proxy data use must be identified in a data quality assessment covering at least 80% of core indicator results, and §4.9.2 mentions a 'limit on the contribution from proxy data', but no numeric cap on proxy data is stated anywhere. No numeric proxy limit was encoded.

Cut-off: the 1%/5% limits apply to mass and energy (EN 15804) and the 5% limit also to environmental impact (ISO 21930). Module groups are A1-A3, A4-A5, B1-B5, B6-B7, C1-C4 and D. Processes excluded by system-boundary rules (personnel, capital goods) are not counted.

Incineration threshold: 60% applies to plants operating and permitted before 2009 and 65% to plants permitted after 2009. ALLOC.08 uses 60% as the floor; the engine needs plant permit data to apply 65%.

Cross-reference errors in the source: §2.2.2 points to Section 4.9.2 for EPD ownership types (actually 4.10); §1.3/§2.1/§2.2.3 point to a 'Section 1.5' that does not exist (ISO 21930 rules are in 1.4); §4.5.2 refers to 'the introduction to Section 4.4' (means 4.5); §4.1 cites 'Section A.7.5'; §5.2 cites 4.6.4 for data quality assessment (means 4.6.5); §4.3.8 has the URL typo 'www.environmental.com/indicators'.
Historical inconsistency: the v1.2 changelog (p.70) says a 0% variation shall be reported for single-site EPDs, but the current §4.10.2 fn 78 forbids this. VAR.05 follows the current text.

Depends on other documents: EN 15804+A2/AC (indicator tables, disclaimers, scenario Tables 10-15, Annex D), EN 15941 (data quality reporting), GPI 5.0.1 (verification, sampling §8.4.3, follow-up §8.4.8, de-registration), ECO Platform standards, and the c-PCRs (EN 16757 concrete, EN 17074 flat glass, EN 16904 plastic piping), which may override defaults such as the Table 4 C-module data and the A4 default scenario.
This PCR replaces the GPI rules on LCA method, LCA report and EPD content (Sections 4-6) (§1.1, p.3). The GPI still governs administration and verification procedures.
IND.07 lists only 'EF 3.1'. The PCR allows later EN 15804 reference packages once announced on environdec.com, so extend the list when a newer package is released.

ISO 21930 compliance is optional. It adds three requirements: product variation of 10% or less (VAR.01), declaration of ISO 21930 indicators for the relevant geography (not encoded because the indicator list depends on ISO 21930 and region), and biogenic carbon in kg CO2 eq. (BIO.03).
